caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed in the center of the composition, enclosed by a rectangular border. The pitcher has a round body that tapers towards a slightly flared rim with a spout, and it features a prominent handle attached to one side. The pitcher is primarily beige or off-white in color, with irregular patches and streaks of green and brown distributed across its surface. The handle is generally light brown to orange in hue, with shading that suggests depth and volume. The base of the pitcher is circular and highlighted with touches of the same brown and orange tones. The background is plain, with the paper color visible, and there are no other objects or details aside from the double-lined rectangular frame around the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
